test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following symptom or indicator does NOT show the failure of an oil pump?

options.text: When the engine oil flow slows or stops, the components continue to be lubricated by hot oil that is not permitted to flow
If a hydraulic lifter in a vehicle creates noise
When the engine runs at a normal temperature and oil flow is steady.
Able to push oil through the system adequately and with low pressure in oil lines

solution:
The correct answer is __When the engine runs at a normal temperature and oil flow is steady.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Oil pump failure__ can lead to insufficient lubrication of engine components.
 
• If the engine oil flow slows or stops, the components may continue to be lubricated by hot oil, which can cause damage.
 
• Noise in hydraulic lifters can be an indicator of oil pump malfunction.
 
• Low pressure in oil lines and inability to push oil adequately through the system are symptoms of oil pump failure.
 
• __However, when the engine runs at a normal temperature and oil flow is steady__, it is NOT an indicator of oil pump failure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Oil Pump Function:**

 
 
• The oil pump ensures that oil circulates throughout the engine to lubricate and cool its components.
 
• Proper functioning of the oil pump is critical for preventing overheating and wear.
 
 
 
• **Symptoms of Oil Pump Failure:**
 
 
• Low oil pressure warning light.
 
• Engine overheating or unusual noises.
 
• Increased engine wear and potential damage.
